speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your dizziness and vertigo, can you describe the nature of the spinning sensation and how long each episode lasts?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

Given your age, the sudden onset of position-dependent vertigo, and your history of hearing loss, I am confident in this assessment. Would you like me to describe the Dix-Hallpike maneuver we can perform to confirm this, or would you prefer immediate treatment instructions?
